# livekit_sip_outbound_trunk (Resource)

An outbound SIP trunk: the SIP provider LiveKit places calls through, and the numbers it calls from. Every change is made in place. Settings the provider does not model, such as media codecs, are kept as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "sip_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "livekit_sip_outbound_trunk" "twilio" {
  name                = "twilio"
  address             = "example.pstn.twilio.com"
  transport           = "tls"
  destination_country = "US"
  numbers             = ["+14155550100"]
  auth_username       = "livekit"
  auth_password       = var.sip_password
  media_encryption    = "require"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Hostname or IP address, optionally with a port, that calls are sent to, such as `example.pstn.twilio.com`. Not a SIP URI: no `sip:` prefix.

### Optional

- `attributes_to_headers` (Map of String) Maps participant attributes (keys) to SIP X-* headers (values) sent with BYE or REFER.
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for SIP digest authentication. The API never returns it, so a password changed outside Terraform is not detected; one that was removed is. It is stored in the state.
- `auth_username` (String) Username for SIP digest authentication. Defaults to `""`, no authentication.
- `destination_country` (String) Country the calls end in, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as `US`, which LiveKit routes by. Defaults to `""`.
- `from_host` (String) Hostname for the `From` header of outbound INVITEs, instead of the project's SIP domain. Defaults to `""`.
- `headers` (Map of String) SIP X-* headers to send with each INVITE, by name.
- `headers_to_attributes` (Map of String) Maps SIP X-* headers of the 200 OK (keys) to participant attributes (values).
- `include_headers` (String) Which 200 OK headers become `sip.h.*` participant attributes automatically. One of `none`, `x_headers`, `all`. Defaults to `none`.
- `media_encryption` (String) Media encryption (SRTP) for calls. One of `disable`, `allow`, `require`. Defaults to `disable`.
- `metadata` (String) Free-form metadata for the trunk. Defaults to `""`.
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the trunk. Defaults to `""`.
- `numbers` (Set of String) Numbers calls are made from; LiveKit picks one at random. Numbers are in E.164 format, such as `+14155550100`.
- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`) the trunk belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the trunk is created; a later change of that default does not move it. Changing this argument replaces the trunk.
- `transport` (String) SIP transport. One of `auto`, `udp`, `tcp`, `tls`. Defaults to `auto`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Trunk ID (`ST_...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an outbound trunk by "<project_id>/<trunk_id>".
terraform import livekit_sip_outbound_trunk.twilio p_abc123/ST_abcdef123456
```
